children: EQT Corp. (EQT) filed a Form 8K - Operations and Financial Condition - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on October 27, 2026.

Today, EQT Corporation ("EQT") issued a news release announcing its third quarter 2026 earnings. A copy of EQT's news release is furnished herewith as Exhibit 99.1 and is incorporated herein by reference.

The information provided in this Item 2.02, including the accompanying Exhibit 99.1, shall be deemed "furnished" and shall not be deemed "filed" for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the "Exchange Act"), or otherwise subject to the liability of such section, nor shall it be incorporated by reference in any filing made by EQT pursuant to the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, or the Exchange Act, regardless of the general incorporation language of such filing, except as expressly set forth by specific reference in such filing.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/33213/000003321326000054/eqt-20261027.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/33213/000003321326000054/0000033213-26-000054-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
